description:
**Namayirira Pharmacy** is now hiring a skilled and reliable **Pharmacy Technician** to join our team. We are a busy pharmacy committed to serving our community with quality medicines, friendly service and careful attention to detail.

## About the role

The successful candidate will support the day-to-day running of the pharmacy, from dispensing medicines to managing stock and educating patients. Working in a fast-paced pharmacy means every day is busy, and your accuracy and organisation make sure nothing goes wrong with a patient's medicines. You will keep the shelves stocked, the records straight and the patients well informed, all while working closely with the rest of the pharmacy team. This role suits a registered pharmacy technician who is organised, trustworthy and used to working in a fast-paced environment where accuracy really matters. You will play a key part in making sure patients get the right medicines, with clear guidance on how to use them safely.

## Key responsibilities

- Dispense medicines accurately and safely to patients
- Manage inventory and stock levels, and restock in good time
- Educate patients on how to use their medicines correctly
- Keep accurate pharmacy and patient records
- Support the pharmacy team during busy periods and maintain a clean, well organised dispensary

## Qualifications and requirements

- Must be registered with the Allied Professionals Council
- At least 2 years of experience working in a fast-paced pharmacy
- Strong attention to detail and a commitment to patient safety
- Good communication skills and a professional attitude
- Reliability and the ability to work well within a busy pharmacy team

## How to apply

Send your cover letter, CV, professional and academic documents to **deossewankambo@gmail.com**.

Applications must be received **not later than 21 August 2026 at 11:59pm**.

Namayirira Pharmacy is an equal opportunity employer. No money or bribes are required at any stage of the recruitment process. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
